_meta.purpose: Real Google reviews shown on the homepage. Populate ONLY with verbatim reviews copied from the studio's own Google Business profile. Never write, paraphrase, embellish or invent an entry here.
policy: Only 5-star reviews are published, per Nishchay's instruction.
Text must be verbatim. Trim with an ellipsis if it is long, never reword.
The section does not render at all while this list is empty, so the homepage never shows a placeholder or an invented review.

No Review or AggregateRating schema is emitted. Google's structured-data policy disallows rich results for self-serving reviews (a business marking up reviews about itself), so the markup would earn nothing and risks a manual action.
_meta.howToFill: For each review copy: author name as shown, the review text, and the month/year. Add {"author":"","text":"","date":"","rating":5} objects to "reviews" below.
